news.body:
## The exit route just changed
- InCorp has offered to cancel the KITAS after you leave
Chitra came back overnight with a 10 percent discount and, more usefully, an ERP cancellation done once you have already flown, instead of an EPO before you go. That is the first option anyone has put forward that does not need your passport in Jakarta while the consulate is holding it. Worth asking her today what ERP requires and whether Locus will sponsor it that way.
## Wednesday needs two things from you
- Where is the courier with your degree certificate?
Fitria needs the originals in your hand on the day, and nothing on the board says where the parcel is. If it is not in Jakarta by Tuesday, telling her on Tuesday is a postponement and telling her on Wednesday morning is a wasted slot.
- She still has not heard back about the 10am slot
She offered Wednesday and nothing has gone back to her. One line confirms it, and you can still move it if the parcel is late.
## Today is the first day the branch is open
- Nobody has had a working day on your in-principle letter yet
You asked for it on Saturday and Indian branches were shut yesterday. Nothing has come back on that thread since you answered their charges question on 6 Oct, and the visa file needs the letter before the 23rd, so a call will be faster than waiting on the reply.
